thread:
Priya: Hi team — brand new workspace, followed the hosted quickstart, pasted the API key into Postman and my first `POST /v1/chat` returns a 402 Payment Required. The dashboard shows my workspace active and I just added a card minutes ago. Anyone seen this? :cry:

Arun: can you paste the exact response body (no api keys)? sometimes we return 402 with a reason field like 'billing:missing_payment_method' or 'billing:over_quota'.

Priya: body: ```{
  "error": {
    "type": "payment_required",
    "message": "Payment required; contact billing",
    "code": 402
  }
}```

Arun: ok that's our generic 402. a few quick checks: is the API key from the same workspace you added the card to? if you accidentally copied a key from a different org or a test service account it will hit billing for that org. also check the workspace billing status in the top-right workspace selector (some users have >1 workspace).

Priya: ohhhh i did create two workspaces during experiments. i think the key was for the old one. switching workspace and generating a new key fixed it — first call now 200. but small UX note: the quickstart page shows a toast "Add payment method to enable first calls" even when the org actually has a card. that confused me.

devex-bot: Created ticket DX-1302: "Quickstart: clarify workspace/key mapping; avoid global billing toast when current workspace has payment method". Suggested fix: add small workspace badge on the quickstart with the workspace name and last-checked billing state.

Nora: also filing a small SDK follow-up: in the JS SDK we should add more descriptive error metadata: include workspace_id and billing_hint (if available) in the 402 so callers can show a direct CTA (switch workspace / update payment).

billing-ops: thanks, assign DX-1302 to me. quick sanity check — if someone has multiple workspaces and uses a key from a workspace without a card, should the response body surface the workspace id? we need to vet data exposure.

Arun: good point. prefer returning a non-sensitive workspace identifier (short-hash) and a safe billing_hint string, rather than raw workspace ids or PII. I'll draft the change and include it in the quickstart guidance.

Priya: thanks all — resolved for me, but leaving this in case others hit the same misleading toast. :sparkles:
